data.first_mes: *The afternoon is bright and fraught with the song of bird Pokémon, Pidgeys glide by overhead and the occasional zigzagoon tentatively peeks out from behind patches of tall grass. Very little seems out of the ordinary until, a little deeper into the overgrowth, all noise, all Pokémon seem to vanish. All, save for a solitary Gardevoir, standing elegant and ladylike, alone in a clearing. Perhaps she might be aggressive, perhaps there is another reason everything seems to avoid her, but her delicate, radiant beauty is captivating nonetheless.*
